def solve(case):
    items = case.get("items")
    required = case.get("required_failure_items")
    if not isinstance(items, list) or not isinstance(required, list):
        raise ValueError("Invalid payload structure")
    # optionally check that all required items are strings in items
    items_set = set(items)
    for r in required:
        if r not in items_set:
            raise ValueError(f"Required item {r} not in items")
    current = list(items)
    attempts = 0
    granularity = 2
    n = len(current)
    while granularity <= n:
        found = False
        for i in range(n - granularity + 1):
            attempts += 1
            chunk = current[i:i+granularity]
            candidate = current[:i] + current[i+granularity:]
            if all(r in candidate for r in required):
                current = candidate
                n = len(current)
                found = True
                break
        if found:
            granularity += 1
        else:
            granularity *= 2
    one_minimal = True
    n = len(current)
    for i in range(n):
        candidate = current[:i] + current[i+1:]
        if all(r in candidate for r in required):
            one_minimal = False
            break
    return {
        "attempts": attempts,
        "one_minimal": one_minimal,
        "reduced_items": current
    }
